claims.source_quote_ar: وَالْمَعْنَى يَتِمُّ بِدُخُولِ الْهَمْزَةِ عَلَى جُمْلَةِ الشَّرْطِ وَالْجَوَابِ
claims.claim_ar: دخول همزة أنّ يتمم المعنى حين تدخُل على الجملة (خصوصًا جملة الشرط والجواب).
claims.claim_en: The meaning is completed by the entry of the hamza; specifically, the hamza 'ʾan' completes the meaning when it enters a sentence (notably conditional and answer clauses).
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited passage discusses the general role of hamzah (e.g. أنّ) in conditional/jawab contexts; applying this general rule to the particle بِأَنَّ in this specific ayah requires confirmation from an explicit statement about بِأَنَّ in the source.
